semanticReview.method: Manual review of the thesis repository metadata and bilingual abstract against the revised article

findings.supports: The record identifies the author, year, title, two SVO/question-guided experiments, duration as the main acoustic correlate, no direct intensity relation, and weaker F0 range expansion relative to comparison Mandarin studies.

limitations: The public abstract does not expose the full thesis text through the current page, which requires a CAPTCHA; article conclusions are limited to the design/results stated in the abstract.
